DROP TABLE IF EXISTS Payment;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS Booking;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS Staff;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS Room;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS Customer;

CREATE TABLE Customer (
    customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    last_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    email VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE,
    phone_number VARCHAR(15)
);

CREATE TABLE Room (
    room_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    room_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    theme VARCHAR(50),
    capacity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    price_per_person REAL NOT NULL,
    difficulty_level VARCHAR(20)
);

CREATE TABLE Booking (
    booking_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    room_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    booking_date DATE NOT NULL,
    time_slot VARCHAR(30),
    group_size INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(20),
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id)
        REFERENCES Customer(customer_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (room_id)
        REFERENCES Room(room_id)
);

CREATE TABLE Staff (
    staff_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    role VARCHAR(50),
    email VARCHAR(100),
    phone_number VARCHAR(15),
    assigned_room_id INTEGER,
    FOREIGN KEY (assigned_room_id)
        REFERENCES Room(room_id)
);

CREATE TABLE Payment (
    payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    booking_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    amount REAL NOT NULL,
    payment_date DATE,
    payment_method VARCHAR(30),
    payment_status VARCHAR(20),
    FOREIGN KEY (booking_id)
        REFERENCES Booking(booking_id)
);

SELECT
    Booking.booking_id,
    Customer.first_name,
    Customer.last_name,
    Booking.booking_date,
    Booking.status
FROM Booking
JOIN Customer
    ON Booking.customer_id = Customer.customer_id;

SELECT
    Room.room_name,
    Booking.booking_date,
    Booking.time_slot,
    Booking.group_size
FROM Booking
JOIN Room
    ON Booking.room_id = Room.room_id;

SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_payment_amount
FROM Payment;

SELECT
    Payment.payment_id,
    Payment.booking_id,
    Payment.amount,
    Payment.payment_method,
    Payment.payment_status
FROM Payment;

SELECT DISTINCT
    Customer.customer_id,
    Customer.first_name,
    Customer.last_name
FROM Customer
JOIN Booking
    ON Customer.customer_id = Booking.customer_id;
